welcome.taskCompany: Company profile for invoice letterheads and documents
welcome.intro: Before your team starts recording transactions, set up these basics. You can change everything later in Settings, and skipped steps stay on a list on the Dashboard.

company.name: Company name
company.nameHint: Legal name, e.g. PT Maju Bersama.
company.addressHint: Printed on invoice and delivery order letterheads.
company.taxIdHint: Optional, you can fill it in later. 15 or 16 digits.
company.saveFailed: Could not save the company profile.

fiscal.emptyDescription: Create a fiscal year in Settings › Fiscal Year after this setup.
fiscal.intro: Transactions can only be recorded in an open fiscal year. New fiscal years and year-end closing are managed in Settings › Fiscal Year.

security.intro: After the password changes, you will be asked to sign in again with the new password. Leave all fields empty if you do not want to change it now.
security.newHint: At least {{min}} characters, with an uppercase letter, a number, and a special character.
security.mismatch: The new passwords do not match.
security.changed: Password changed. Sign in again with your new password.

password.min: The new password must be at least {{min}} characters.
password.upper: The new password must include an uppercase letter.
password.digit: The new password must include a number.
password.special: The new password must include a special character.
